definitions.gloss: late-night bus; overnight bus; night bus
definitions.explanation: A bus that operates during late-night hours, including long-distance overnight buses that travel between cities while passengers sleep.

examples.japanese: {深夜|しんや}バスで{大阪|おおさか}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: To go to Osaka by night bus.

examples.japanese: {深夜|しんや}バスは{新幹線|しんかんせん}より{安|やす}い。
examples.english: Night buses are cheaper than the bullet train.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}の{頃|ころ}は{節約|せつやく}のために{深夜|しんや}バスをよく{利用|りよう}していた。
examples.english: When I was a student, I often used night buses to save money.

notes:
A compound of {深夜|しんや} (late night) and バス (bus). Refers both to local late-night bus services and to long-distance overnight highway buses ({高速|こうそく}{夜行|やこう}バス) that are popular as a budget alternative to the {新幹線|しんかんせん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {深夜|しんや}バスに{乗|の}る: to ride a night bus
- {深夜|しんや}バスの{予約|よやく}: night bus reservation
- {深夜|しんや}バスで{移動|いどう}する: to travel by night bus
- {深夜|しんや}バスの{時刻表|じこくひょう}: night bus timetable

CULTURAL CONTEXT:
Overnight highway buses are a major part of Japan's transportation network, connecting major cities at a fraction of the cost of the {新幹線|しんかんせん}. They are especially popular among students and budget travelers. Modern versions offer reclining seats, privacy curtains, and individual entertainment systems.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {夜行|やこう}バス: overnight bus — emphasizes traveling through the night; essentially synonymous
- {高速|こうそく}バス: highway bus — long-distance bus, may run day or night
- {終電|しゅうでん}: last train — the final train of the day, often the reason people take a night bus instead
